metadata.defaultTitle: ATS readability — see your CV the way the parser does
metadata.description: Read a CV the way an applicant tracking system reads it: what parses, what is missing, and which terms from the job ad never appear. Scored in your browser, stored for 12 months.
metadata.openGraphDescription: See your CV the way the parser does.

common.disclaimer: The checks are heuristics built from how mainstream parsers behave, not a reproduction of any named vendor. A good score means nothing is standing between your CV and a human reader; it is not a prediction that you will be invited.

home.headline: Your CV is read as text, not as a design.
home.lede: ATS readability is a free tool that shows a CV the way an applicant tracking system reads it: as text. It scores what survived out of 100 and lists the fixes in order of value.
home.privacyTag: Scored in your browser. Stored for 12 months.

analyze.label: Analysis and match
analyze.title: Every lost point has a name.
analyze.body: Parseability, keywords, structure, impact and contact add up to 100. Each deduction names the line it came from and what to write instead. Add a job ad and the keyword check reads against it.

tracker.label: Application tracker
tracker.title: Know where each application stands.
tracker.body: Move every application through saved, applied, interview, offer and rejected, with a reminder when one goes quiet. The board lives on your device and can be exported at any time.

interview.label: Interview preparation
interview.title: Practice with your own material.
interview.body: Story cards are cut from your CV, never invented, and mapped to common questions. Practice mode suggests the card that best fits your answer. Questions drawn from a job ad need a model you choose to turn on.

closing.title: Read your CV the way the parser does.

how.title: How the reading works
how.body: The reader extracts text from a PDF, DOCX or plain text file, rebuilding lines from glyph positions so line breaks and column gaps survive. Those signals tell it where one section ends and the next begins. The text is then scored across five dimensions worth 100 points: parseability 25, keyword match 25, structure 20, impact 20 and contact 10. Every lost point is charged to a named finding, with the line it came from and what to write instead, and findings are listed most expensive first. Without a job ad the keyword dimension is capped at 20 of 25 points, and the report says so. The reading and scoring run in your browser; the CV is then stored for 12 months, see the privacy notice.

about.title: About
about.privacy: Your CV is read and scored in your browser. When you analyze it, the file, its text and the result are also stored on our server for 12 months and then deleted.
about.formats: The editor imports and exports the <link>JSON Resume</link> format.

upload.a: Yes. Your CV is read and scored in your browser first. When you analyze it, the file, its text and the result are also sent to our server and kept for 12 months, then deleted. See the privacy notice.

score.a: Five dimensions add up to 100 points: parseability 25, keyword match 25, structure 20, impact 20, contact 10. Every lost point is attached to a named finding with a fix.

languages.a: Section headings, action verbs and stopwords are recognised in English, German and Turkish, and the document language is detected automatically.

shared.q: What does a shared report store?
shared.a: Scores and advice only. Lines taken from your CV are never stored, and the link expires after 30 days.

guarantee.q: Does a high score mean I will be invited?
guarantee.a: No. The checks are heuristics built from how mainstream parsers behave, not a reproduction of any named vendor. A good score means nothing stands between your CV and a human reader.

noAd.q: What changes without a job ad?
noAd.a: The keyword dimension is capped at 20 of 25 points and the report says so; a generic skill list is not a match score.

section6.content: Your CV, extracted text, and analysis results are stored for 12 months from the upload date and then automatically deleted from all storage locations. You can request earlier deletion.

section7.title: 7. Automated Decision-Making
section7.content: The analysis score describes how readable your CV is for applicant tracking systems. It is not a decision about you and has no legal or similarly significant effect.

section8.title: 8. Your Rights
section8.content: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability, and objection. Contact {controllerEmail} or use the Data Request form. We will respond within 30 days.

section9.title: 9. Important Notice
section9.content: Please remove special category data (health, religion, trade union membership, etc.) and third-party details (referees) from your CV before uploading. They are not needed for the analysis.
